provenance: Generated synthetic Indian charging data supplied by the team; generator code, seed and reuse licence not supplied.
timezone: Asia/Kolkata; explicit local-wall-time parsing and localization; CSV exports retain DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM plus Timezone.

policy.exact_duplicates: Keep first input occurrence; compare all original fields.
policy.flagged_output: Includes accepted and rejected records with any quality reason.
policy.source_row_number: 1-based CSV record number including header; not physical line for multiline fields.
policy.validation_scope: Reason counts use rows after exact deduplication; station checks include rejected rows.

coverage.calendar_average_assumption: Future averages assume complete collection across the inclusive range, including zero-session dates.
coverage.limitation: Observed timestamps do not verify collection uptime or complete first/last-day coverage. Boundary months may be partial; timezone is Asia/Kolkata for the supplied synthetic dataset.

port_validation.policy: Station-local ports; occupancy intervals [Session_Start, Session_End). Touching endpoints allowed. All overlap participants flagged, not silently discarded.

synthetic_assumptions: Supplied generated Indian data: local Asia/Kolkata times, named station/area/location categories, station-local integer ports, separate arrival/active charging/occupancy. Generator seed, distributions, losses and licence not provided; constraints are checked against CSV values, not invented.

derived_features.Is_Weekend: Boolean: Saturday or Sunday session start.
derived_features.Calculated_Session_Duration_Min: Session end minus start, in minutes of port occupancy.
derived_features.Arrival_Hour: Local arrival hour, integer 0–23; different from session-start demand.
derived_features.Station_Port_Key: Station_ID and Port_ID joined by /; port IDs are local to stations.

derived_feature_policy: Accepted records always recompute these columns from explicitly parsed timestamps, replacing supplied derived values. Exact duplicates still compare all supplied original fields.

measurement_policy.valid: Finite numeric value >= 0; zero allowed. Blank/null is missing; explicit NaN/infinity text is nonfinite; other unparseable text is nonnumeric; finite values < 0 are negative.
measurement_policy.demand_eligibility: Measurement validity and plausibility flags never reject a demand row; missing values are never zero-filled.
measurement_policy.plausibility: Compare valid energy against finite nonnegative battery kWh and nominal charger kW times calculated active charging minutes / 60 (Charging_End minus Session_Start; 1e-6 kWh comparison tolerance). Nullable flags: blank means not evaluable. Concerns do not invalidate basic numeric energy validity or cause exclusion.
measurement_policy.limitations: Synthetic consistency checks, not verification of real equipment or observations. Occupancy and active charging are separate. No physical corrections or invented upper cutoffs.
